title: A Gomory cut in the original variables
heading: A Gomory Cut Comes From Any Tableau Row With a Fractional Right-Hand Side
cases: a row with fractional entries under both slacks gives the cut the formula states
with three rows and three slacks, every slack's fractional part is substituted
an entry of -1/5 has fractional part 4/5, since the floor of -1/5 is -1
an original variable with a fractional entry keeps a term of its own in the cut
